page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: fuit, longissimè procurrens cum pago proximo Helpenâ, qui v i i r stadiis non minùs ab urbe receßit, continuâ domo-rum serie penè se conjunxit. Et præter suburbia hæc totoMeridionali & Septem-trionali latere in eodem dorso editiore, in quo urbs est sita, amœnis ac sumptu-ôsis hortis, & ædificiis elegantibus totus post pomœria locus longè lateque obsitus ac contectus fuit. Taceo insulas virorum nobilium complures in Meridionali potissimúm plaga. Cuncta nunc per bellum vastata, vix pauca hic illic instaura-ta: in Borea verò plagâ urbis novæ mœnia illa magnifica ac firma, de quibus paulò antè dixi, excitata, sed nondum perfecta. page.notes: The left-margin note is set in italic and split across two lines ("Commo-" / "litas fum."); read as "Commoditas sum.", uncertain in its first word. The long s in the note is read as a plain s. "potissimúm" carries an accent as printed. The catchword "tari" sits at the right below the last line. A decorative mark appears in "complures in" and is not a reference mark, so it is not transcribed. Faint ink spots on the left and the Google watermark at the lower right are not printed text and are omitted.
